name: Éle
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Éle is a legendary Irish figure. Most accounts overlook her. Her sister Medb is the famous queen and goddess of Ireland. The name Éle links her to the Fairy race. That race is also called the elfin race.

attributes.attribute: legendary figure overlooked beside her sister Medb
